cmd.description: Open the party finder wizard interface.

welcome:
Welcome to party finder wizard interface!
Please select your request:
onlyHostEdit: ❌ Only the **host** or an **admin** can edit this listing's date & time.
onlyHostDelete: ❌ Only the **host** or an **admin** can delete this PF listing.
confirmDelete:
⚠️ **Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?**
This will remove the channel announcement and clear this Party Finder listing permanently.
alreadyDeleted: ⚠️ **Notice:** This Party Finder listing has already been deleted or does not exist.
expiredStart: ❌ Session expired. Please start over using `/pf`.

✏️ **Edit Party Size**
Current Name: **{name}**
Select your new **Party Size**:
published: @here A new Party Finder listing has been published!

photo.custom: 🖼️ **Photo Status:** Custom cover photo was successfully attached and used!
photo.random: 🎲 **Photo Status:** Cover photo field was left blank, successfully loaded a random preset image from JSON!

photo.presetFailed: ⚠️ **Photo Status:** Preset image lookup failed or json files are empty.
photo.blank: ℹ️ **Photo Status:** Cover photo was left blank.

posted: 🎉 **Party Finder successfully posted to the channel!**{photo}
